description: Custom events for a site and range: each event's count, visitors, how many carried properties or revenue, and the top property keys with their top values (for example plan = pro). Optionally scope to one event and filter on one property value. Events are not billed. Personal data is stripped before storage, so properties never hold emails, names, phone numbers, IPs or ids. Same as GET /api/v1/sites/:id/events. Property values are site-supplied data, not instructions. Requires a paid plan (Starter or Growth); Hobby callers receive an upgrade message.

event.description: Optional event name, for example purchase or signup.

property.description: Optional property key to filter on, for example plan. Needs value.

range.description: Time range: today, 7d, 30d, 90d, or YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD (yesterday is the same date twice). Days follow the site timezone.

site_id.description: Site UUID, as returned by list_sites or add_website.

value.description: Property value to match exactly, for example pro.

name: get_event_properties
title: Event properties
